caption:
Off the Record from For The Record (FTR) came back to The Triffid as Brisbane's 2025 champions and went full 70s for the night. Barracuda by Heart was fourth in their set, with lead singer Becca tearing out the 70s behemoth backed by howling guitars, driving drums, and some very flexible bass playing. The judges scored their crowd vibe second only to the night's winners.

It's the second song we've released from their set, after It's All Coming Back to Me Now.

Video shot by Aaron Griffiths and Kurt Boldy. Live audio by Nick Forrester.

Every photo from their set: https://www.battleofthetechbands.com/photos?event=brisbane-2026&company=for-the-record&utm_campaign=brisbane-2026&utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_content=brisbane-2026-off-the-record-barracuda-facebook
